metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about changes in tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing between two specific time periods in 2020. I need to: 1. Use Sentinel-5P data which provides tropospheric NO2 measurements 2. Compare mean NO2 levels between: - January 1-20, 2020 - February 10-25, 2020 3. Check if levels decreased in February compared to January For data collection: - Use Sentinel-5P OFFL/L3_NO2 collection - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' - Geometry: Beijing area (I'll use a polygon around Beijing) - Date filters for the two periods For processing: - Calculate mean NO2 for each period - Check if February mean < January mean Potential issues: - Empty collections (C1) - try to recover by widening date range if needed - No valid pixels (C2) - check pixel counts - Invalid calculations (C3) - validate results are reasonable Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const beijing = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [115.5, 39.4], [117.5, 39.4], [117.5, 41.1], [115.5, 41.1], [115.5, 39.4] ]); const janDates = ['2020-01-01', '2020-01-20']; const febDates = ['2020-02-10', '2020-02-25']; // 2. Data Acquisition const janCollection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(janDates[0], janDates[1]) .filterBounds(beijing) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const febCollection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(febDates[0], febDates[1]) .filterBounds(beijing) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection sizes const janSize = janCollection.size().getInfo(); const febSize = febCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan Images: ${janSize}, Feb Images: ${febSize}`); if (janSize === 0 || febSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NO2 for each period const janMean = janCollection.mean(); const febMean = febCollection.mean(); // Count valid pixels const janCount = janMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: beijing, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const febCount = febMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: beijing, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan Pixels: ${janCount}, Feb Pixels: ${febCount}`); if (janCount === 0 || febCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean values const janValue = janMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: beijing, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const febValue = febMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: beijing, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan NO2: ${janValue?.toFixed(6)}, Feb NO2: ${febValue?.toFixed(6)}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (janValue === null || febValue === null || isNaN(janValue) || isNaN(febValue) || janValue < 0 || febValue < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (febValue < janValue) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
